blocks.text: 2p orbital ki electron density Figure 2.6 mein dikhayi gayi hai. Yahan density s orbital ki tarah har taraf barabar (spherical) nahi phaili. Balke p orbital ke kisi ek axis par do lobes (gubbare jaise hisse) hote hain. Jis axis par lobes hon, usi ke naam par orbitals px, py aur pz kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: x, y aur z mehwaron par teen hisse, har ek p orbital jis ke do lobes nucleus par milte hain, ek bhara hua aur ek sirf khaake wala, + nishan ke saath: 2px x mehwar par (l = 1, m = +1), 2py y mehwar par (l = 1, m = -1) aur 2pz z mehwar par (l = 1, m = 0).
blocks.caption: Figure 2.6: Teen 2p orbitals (kitab ki Figure 2.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen drawings: 2px ke lobes x axis par, 2py ke y axis par aur 2pz ke z axis par. Teeno ke liye ℓ = 1; m ki teen qeematein (+1, −1, 0) teen orientations hain. Beech mein nucleus par electron density zero hai.

items: p orbital ke ek axis par do lobes; px, py, pz teen axes par, m ki har qeemat ke liye ek.
